realcraft.settings.title: RealCraft Realism Settings
realcraft.settings.common_note: Gameplay setting: applies in singleplayer and on servers that use this config.
realcraft.settings.preset_tooltip: Apply the %s performance preset (sets the limits below).
death.attack.realcraft.glass_shards: %1$s was cut to pieces by broken glass
realcraft.option.structuralPhysics.desc: Natural blocks (tags realcraft:physics_rigid / physics_loose) collapse when they lose support.
realcraft.option.rockOverhangSpan.desc: How many blocks sideways rock can reach to find support before it caves in.
realcraft.option.soilOverhangSpan.desc: How many blocks sideways dirt, grass and similar soils can reach for support.
realcraft.option.maxSupportChecksPerTick: Performance limit: support checks processed per tick in each dimension.
realcraft.option.maxCollapsesPerTick.des: Performance limit: blocks that may start falling per tick in each dimension.
realcraft.option.maxQueuedChecks.desc: Performance limit: pending support checks are dropped beyond this many (stops endless cave-ins).
realcraft.option.rockCrumbles.desc: Collapsing stone turns into cobblestone, grass into dirt, and so on.
realcraft.option.fallingBlockDamage.desc: Damage per block fallen dealt by collapsing blocks (max 40).
realcraft.option.explosionDebris.desc: Explosions hurl some of the destroyed blocks through the air instead of deleting them.
realcraft.option.debrisChance.desc: Chance for each destroyed block to become flying debris.
realcraft.option.maxDebrisPerExplosion.d: Performance limit: flying debris blocks per explosion.
realcraft.option.breakableGlass.desc: Glass and glass panes (tag realcraft:shatterable) shatter from hits, impacts and blasts.
realcraft.option.projectilesShatterGlass: Arrows and tridents fly through glass, shattering it.
Minimum projectile speed (blocks/tick) needed to break glass.
realcraft.option.impactsShatterGlass.des: Sprinting into glass or landing on it from a height breaks it.
realcraft.option.impactShatterSpeed.desc: Horizontal speed (blocks/tick) needed to crash through glass. Sprinting is about 0.28.
realcraft.option.fallShatterDistance.des: Fall distance in blocks needed to break glass you land on.
Glass within this many blocks of an explosion shatters from the shockwave.
realcraft.option.glassCutDamage.desc: Damage taken when crashing through glass with your body.
realcraft.option.waterCurrentStrength.de: Extra push from flowing water (vanilla is about 0.014).
realcraft.option.armorSinking.desc: Wearing heavy armor drags you down in water.
realcraft.option.armorSinkStrength.desc: Downward pull per armor point while swimming.
realcraft.option.lavaHeat.desc: Standing right next to lava sets you on fire.
realcraft.option.lavaHeatRadius.desc: How close (in blocks) you must be to lava to catch fire.
realcraft.option.steamClouds.desc: Water meeting lava bursts into clouds of steam.
realcraft.option.removeBedrock.desc: Replaces the overworld bedrock floor in new chunks.
realcraft.option.removeNetherBedrock.des: Replaces the nether bedrock floor and roof in new chunks.
realcraft.option.hellUnderground.desc: The deepest overworld layers turn into a hellscape of netherrack, magma, fire and lava lakes.
realcraft.option.hellTopY.desc: Height where the hell layer begins (it blends over a few blocks).
realcraft.option.hellLavaLevel.desc: Open caves in the hell layer are flooded with lava up to this height.
realcraft.option.hellFireChance.desc: Chance for exposed hell floors to be burning.
realcraft.option.hellGlowstoneChance.des: Chance for hell ceilings to grow glowstone.
realcraft.option.hellConvertOres.desc: Gold and coal ores in the hell layer become nether gold and nether quartz; rarer ores stay.
realcraft.option.smoothTerrainStepAssist: Players step up full blocks so smoothed slopes can be walked without jumping.
realcraft.option.darknessStealth.desc: Hostile mobs have a much harder time spotting you in the dark or while sneaking.
realcraft.option.herdPanic.desc: Hurting a passive animal makes the rest of its herd flee as well.
realcraft.option.herdRadius.desc: How far a herd panic spreads.
realcraft.option.locationalDamage.desc: Projectiles to the head deal extra damage; leg hits slow the target.
realcraft.option.woundedLimping.desc: Badly hurt creatures (and players) move slower.
realcraft.option.limpHealthFraction.desc: Fraction of max health below which creatures start limping.
realcraft.option.impactParticles.desc: Hits spray particles that match the creature (red for flesh, bone for skeletons, slime for slimes).
realcraft.option.massKnockback.desc: Big creatures are knocked back less, small ones more.
realcraft.option.corpseTicks.desc: How long (in ticks) dead creatures stay in the world, so ragdolls have time to settle. Vanilla is 20.
realcraft.option.smoothTerrain.desc: Renders natural terrain (tag realcraft:smoothable) as smooth surfaces instead of cubes.
realcraft.option.cameraShake.desc: Shake the camera on impacts and blasts.
realcraft.option.shakeOnExplosions.desc: Explosions shake the camera by distance.
realcraft.option.shakeOnLanding.desc: Landing from a height jolts the camera.
realcraft.option.shakeOnEnvironment.desc: Thunder, roars, sonic booms and nearby cave-ins rumble the camera.
realcraft.option.ragdolls.desc: Dying creatures topple and tumble with physics instead of the stiff death flip.
realcraft.option.ragdollDistance.desc: Ragdolls are only simulated within this many blocks.
realcraft.option.itemPhysics.desc: Dropped items lie flat on the ground and tumble through the air.
realcraft.option.maxRenderedItemsPerStac: Performance limit: models drawn for one dropped stack.
realcraft.option.hellFog.desc: Thick red fog in the Nether and in the hell layer.
realcraft.option.hellFogDensity.desc: How thick the hell fog is.
realcraft.option.ambientParticles.desc: Ash and embers drift around you in hell.
realcraft.option.particleDensity.desc: Performance limit: amount of ambient and effect particles.
realcraft.option.hellSounds.desc: Rumbles and moans echo through the hell layer.
realcraft.option.bigSplashes.desc: Creatures falling into water throw up big splashes.
realcraft.option.digToNether.desc: Digging through the bottom of the overworld drops you into the Nether (needs bedrock removed).
realcraft.option.netherVoidToOverworld.d: Falling through the bottom of the Nether drops you out of the overworld sky.
realcraft.option.zombieInfection.desc: Zombie bites can infect players. Untreated, the infection turns the player into a zombie.
realcraft.option.infectionChance.desc: Chance that a zombie hit infects you.
realcraft.option.infectionMinutes.desc: How long the infection takes to turn you. Eat a golden apple before then to cure it.
realcraft.option.zombifiedSunburn.desc: Zombified players catch fire in sunlight unless they wear a helmet.
Zombies treat zombified players as one of their own.
realcraft.option.golemsHuntZombified.des: Iron golems attack zombified players on sight.
realcraft.option.realisticClouds.desc: Replaces the flat vanilla clouds with tall, shaded, drifting cumulus clouds that thicken in bad weather.
realcraft.option.cloudCoverage.desc: How much of the sky is cloudy in clear weather.
realcraft.option.cloudThickness.desc: Maximum height of a cloud in blocks.
realcraft.option.cloudDistance.desc: Performance limit: cloud draw radius in 16-block cells.
realcraft.option.realisticWaterColor.des: Deeper, more natural blue-green water instead of the bright vanilla blue.
realcraft.option.underwaterVisibility.de: Clear in the shallows, dark in the deep, murky in swamps and at night.
realcraft.option.waterfallMist.desc: Waterfalls throw up mist and foam where they land.
realcraft.option.realisticAnimations.des: Breathing, head bob and swaying arms; zombies shamble with lolling heads and a dragging leg.
realcraft.zombie.bitten: You've been bitten! Eat a golden apple before the infection takes over.
realcraft.zombie.fever: You feel feverish... the bite is getting worse.
realcraft.zombie.infection_cured: The fever breaks. The infection is gone.
realcraft.zombie.turned: You have turned into a zombie! To cure it: splash yourself with Weakness, then eat a golden apple.
realcraft.zombie.risen: You rose again... as a zombie.
realcraft.abyss.nether: You fell through the bottom of the world... into the Nether.
realcraft.abyss.overworld: You fell out of the Nether... and out of the sky.
